description: Maya is arranging temporary care for the family's dog during a week of noisy home renovations and must make the final call about the dog's homes, exercise, medication, and noise protection, with input from her brother, cousin, and aunt.

shared_context.S1: Maya's kitchen and living room will be renovated from 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-17, with demolition and power-tool work during the daytime.
shared_context.S2: The family dog, Pepper, will need a safe care arrangement away from the renovation area during that period.
shared_context.S3: Maya is responsible for choosing Pepper's care plan and making sure the plan is carried out.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing a care plan, Maya routinely checks with each person present for relevant information, availability, and practical concerns.
shared_context.S5: Pepper normally eats twice a day and is used to sleeping in a crate.
shared_context.S6: Maya can finalize the plan with a named person assigned to research and confirm the second-window caregiver; the caregiver does not need to be identified during this discussion.

PF1.text: Jonah spoke with Pepper's veterinarian yesterday. The veterinarian said Pepper must stay on one floor, have walks limited to 20 minutes at a time, and receive medicine at exactly 08:00 and 20:00 during the renovation; Jonah has not yet shared this with Maya.

PF2.text: Priya has already promised that Pepper can stay at her house from exactly 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-14, but she cannot keep Pepper after 18:00 on 2026-08-14; she has not yet told Maya about the specific availability.

PF3.text: Pepper's trainer, Luis Moreno, told Rosa that Pepper becomes distressed by power-tool noise and should be kept in Pepper's familiar crate with white noise, with no exposure to the renovation area; Rosa has not passed this recommendation to the family.

acceptance_conditions: Pepper must stay at Priya's house from August 10 through 18:00 on August 14, followed by a boarding facility, professional pet sitter, or similar arrangement arranged or confirmed by Maya for the remaining renovation period.
A commitment must establish the August 14 transition from Priya to a second caregiver, even if that caregiver is still to be identified.
Pepper must remain on one floor throughout the renovation.
Pepper's walks must be limited to exactly 20 minutes at a time.
Pepper's medicine must be given exactly at 08:00 and 20:00.
Pepper must use the familiar crate with white noise and have no exposure to the renovation area.
A medication-administration commitment specifying exactly 08:00 and 20:00 must exist.
Jonah's veterinarian information must be cited as justification after Jonah reveals it.

decisive_facts.why: The veterinarian's instructions change the plan to one-floor care, an exact 20-minute walk limit, medicine at exactly 08:00 and 20:00, and a commitment that records those exact medication times.
Priya's exact availability changes the care plan to Priya's house through the 18:00 pickup deadline on August 14, followed by a second-caregiver transition covering the rest of the renovation.
The trainer's recommendation changes the noise plan to Pepper's familiar crate with white noise and explicit separation from the renovation area.
